agentGuide: Base path /gmail/v1/users/me. List: GET /gmail/v1/users/me/messages?q=is:unread newer_than:2d&maxResults=10 (ids only; q uses Gmail search syntax: from:, subject:, has:attachment, label:); one: GET /gmail/v1/users/me/messages/<id>?format=full (payload.headers for From/Subject/Date, body in payload.parts[].body.data, base64url) or ?format=metadata&metadataHeaders=From&metadataHeaders=Subject for a cheap read. Labels: GET /gmail/v1/users/me/labels; mark read or move: POST /gmail/v1/users/me/messages/<id>/modify {"removeLabelIds": ["UNREAD"], "addLabelIds": ["Label_1"]}; trash: POST .../messages/<id>/trash. Threads: GET /gmail/v1/users/me/threads/<id>. Send: POST /gmail/v1/users/me/messages/send {"raw": "<base64url of an RFC 2822 message: To:, Subject:, blank line, body>"} (add "threadId" and In-Reply-To/References headers to reply). An attachment: GET .../messages/<id>/attachments/<attachmentId> (data base64url, use save_as). A 403 means the scope was not granted at connection. Sending asks for confirmation.
